projects.title: Projects

cloudflare_detail.empty_description: Create one or sync from Cloudflare to import existing ones.

projects_new.title: New project
projects_new.description: A logical grouping for your multi-tenant templates and clients.

templates_new.title: New template
templates_new.description: Define the source and build strategy of a reusable image.
templates_new.help_watch_paths: Comma-separated glob patterns. The webhook triggers only if something under these paths changes.
templates_new.help_build_type: It's the strategy used to build the Docker image. Dockerfile uses your own Dockerfile, Compose uses docker-compose, Nixpacks auto-detects the stack.
templates_new.slug_invalid: Slug must start with a letter, lowercase with hyphens (max 31).
templates_new.watch_paths_hint: Globs one per line. Only changes in these paths trigger a build.
templates_new.detect_title: Shallow-clones the repo and auto-detects Dockerfile / Compose / Nixpacks
templates_new.detect_missing_url: Provide the git repo URL first.
templates_new.build_type_compose: Docker Compose — multiple services from compose.yml
templates_new.build_type_nixpacks: Nixpacks — auto-detects language (Node, Python, Go, Rust, ...). Does not require a Dockerfile.
templates_new.build_strategy_hint: It's the strategy to build the image. The runtime executing it (Docker or Podman) is configured per VM in Satellite:ContainerRuntime.
templates_new.nixpacks_hint: Nixpacks detects the stack automatically. Does not require a Dockerfile. The satellite running the build must have `nixpacks` in the PATH (install with `curl -fsSL https://nixpacks.com/install.sh | bash`).
templates_new.build_args_empty: No args. Add key/value pairs to inject into the build.
templates_new.webhook_secret_one_time_title: The webhook secret is only shown once
templates_new.webhook_secret_one_time_description: Copy it and configure it in your Git provider (GitHub/Gitlab) now. If you lose it, rotate it from the template detail.
templates_new.webhook_secret_missing: The API did not return a webhook secret. Verify the contract.

clients_new.title: New client
clients_new.description: A concrete tenant under this project.

instances_new.title: New instance
instances_new.description: An instance deploys this template for a client in an environment.
instances_new.help_custom_domain: Optional. If empty, the generated auto-hostname is used.
instances_new.help_auto_deploy: When there is a green build, it is deployed here automatically.
instances_new.no_clients: There are no clients in this project
instances_new.slug_hint: Aethra builds containerName and hostname from this.
instances_new.custom_domain_hint: Optional. If empty, the auto-hostname template-client-env.base_domain is used.
instances_new.auto_deploy_label: Auto-deploy when a new green build is detected
instances_new.ports_empty: No ports. Add one if your container exposes any.
instances_new.healthcheck_test_hint: One line per argument. E.g. CMD-SHELL / curl ...

vms_new.title: Register VM
vms_new.description: Connect a new VM to the control plane. You can install the satellite with an auto-generated script.
vms_new.help_ssh: The control plane uses this to connect via SSH during auto-install.

services_new.title: Create shared service
services_new.description: Provision a Postgres/Redis/RabbitMQ that your apps will consume via bindings.
services_new.help_exposed: If disabled, the service is only accessible from the internal network.
services_new.slug_invalid: Only lowercase, digits and hyphens; must start with a letter (max 31).
services_new.target_vm_hint: VM where the service container will run.
services_new.exposed_hint: By default the service is only accessible via the internal Docker network. Enable to open the port on the VM (e.g. connect DBeaver).

bindings_new.title: New binding
bindings_new.description: Connect an application to this service so it receives credentials via env vars.
bindings_new.help_resource: Postgres: database name. Redis: key prefix. Default: the app slug.
bindings_new.help_env_prefix: Variables are injected as PREFIX_HOST, PREFIX_USER, etc.
bindings_new.help_migrations_hook: If active, app deploy runs migrations before swap.
bindings_new.hook_command_error: Provide the migrations hook command or disable it.
bindings_new.no_apps_description: Create an application in a project before binding it to a service.
bindings_new.resource_hint: Resource name (database, queue, etc.). If empty, it is auto-generated from the application slug.
bindings_new.perm_owner_hint: Full access. Recommended for migrations and administration.
bindings_new.perm_readwrite_hint: Read and write on the resource, without DDL or admin.
bindings_new.perm_readonly_hint: Read-only. Useful for dashboards, reports or replicas.
bindings_new.env_prefix_hint: Added to the injected env vars (e.g. "DB_" → DB_URL, DB_PASSWORD).
bindings_new.migrations_hook_hint: Aethra runs the command inside the application container based on the event you choose.
bindings_new.hook_command_hint_postgres: E.g. "npx prisma migrate deploy" or "alembic upgrade head".
bindings_new.hook_command_hint_default: Command to run inside the application container.
bindings_new.hook_fail_on_label: Fail the deploy if the hook fails
bindings_new.hook_fail_on_hint: If active, a non-zero exit code aborts the deploy and rolls back the binding.

cloudflare_new.help_token: Token with Zone.DNS:Edit scope. Encrypted with DataProtection before storage.

cloudflare_record_new.title: New DNS record
cloudflare_record_new.description: Create a record in this zone via API v4.
cloudflare_record_new.help_name: Without the root domain suffix. Use @ for the apex.

settings_domains.label_wildcard_confirmed: I confirm wildcard DNS is configured

settings_api_keys.help_name: Human label to identify it in the list.
settings_api_keys.help_scopes: Select the permissions this key will need. Least privilege recommended.

settings_api_keys.secret_description: This is the only time you'll see the secret. Copy and save it somewhere safe.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configuration for your account, credentials and workspace secrets.
settings.users_description: Human accounts with access to Aethra and the RBAC roles that define their permissions.
